lxc_274768d25b9a605d.text: First we look at the Boston Celtics and their long run of titles.

lxc_a41676eafc845871.text: Next come the Los Angeles Lakers, a team that moved cities, and then the Chicago Bulls and their two groups of three titles.

lxc_4dc8d0a87cc80a40.text: After that we meet the Golden State Warriors and their record seasons.

lxc_35731caea84144e0.text: At the end, we put all four teams side by side.

lxc_6c9f9c138bb18aa7.text: Imagine your school team wins the final this year.

lxc_46310eec00ed51fd.text: Then it wins next year, and the year after that.

lxc_a48a4fcc4c4cbeab.text: Now imagine it wins eight years in a row.

lxc_471d66283ec72649.text: That really happened to the Boston Celtics.

lxc_0f0f009ea8f886d0.text: They were one of the first eight teams in the NBA.

lxc_3887ac33208b0cfa.text: Their name, the Celtics, comes from the Irish history of many families in Boston.

lxc_2ec9f88f5b818538.text: Today they play at a building called TD Garden.

lxc_f7e84d8bf560a7c1.text: The Celtics have won 18 NBA championships.

lxc_8d64f0b4a0d15f92.text: A championship is the title for the best team at the end of a season.

lxc_500d021adc2edee6.text: But look at when the titles came.

lxc_3640411721f104d3.text: From 1959 to 1966, the Celtics won every year.

lxc_56d2f19ff00a8d09.text: Then they won again in 1968 and 1969.

lxc_778814ef942c0a9e.text: Bill Russell played for the team and also coached it at the same time.

lxc_c052a7e7672c2230.text: So, many Celtics titles came close together, in about ten years.

lxc_70e901bb0e116de4.text: Their 18th title came much later, in 2024.

lxc_e03295301f70aadf.text: Two years before that, in 2022, they played in the Finals but lost to the Warriors.

lxc_f14423e9a292e496.text: The Celtics stayed in one city.

lxc_1a5b6f55979e9523.text: Their story is also a story about travel.

lxc_ca0fbf2548e3496b.text: The team started in 1946 with a different name: the Detroit Gems.

lxc_a1b817248138ed81.text: Later the team moved to Minneapolis.

lxc_45b4deef9cf345a3.text: Then, in 1960, it moved again, to Los Angeles.

lxc_0cf74df46e3c0851.text: So the Lakers have lived in three cities.

lxc_3c5be4ae2e9dd0ae.text: Because these two teams are so close in titles, their games against each other always feel important.

lxc_c4bbfbe6aa5f5da1.text: That year, the Lakers chose a new young player, Magic Johnson.

lxc_a8d7e05d4a6c31fa.text: Later, the Lakers won a championship by beating the Celtics in Boston, in the Celtics' own city.

lxc_eefed88c9c9980e0.text: For Lakers fans, that win meant more than a normal title.

lxc_2d7d62598bfa83c6.text: So the Lakers' 17 titles are not only a number.

lxc_0e8cbc7b171edbbf.text: They belong to a team that changed cities and beat its biggest rival in Boston.

lxc_46437ad66839bbda.text: The Chicago Bulls have fewer titles than the Celtics or the Lakers.

lxc_8347398895a3e3ee.text: But they won them in a very short time.

lxc_ab41a44d8e9ce281.text: The Bulls won six NBA championships between 1991 and 1998.

lxc_a92d6b728c399de5.text: First, they won three championships in a row, from 1991 to 1993.

lxc_c94b7695d1c63a1b.text: Then they stopped for a short time.

lxc_fc13f1b79f7ddb8b.text: After that, they won three championships in a row again, from 1996 to 1998.

lxc_f331d661da4388d7.text: So the Bulls won three in a row two times.

lxc_89dfaaa2006e1b8a.text: One shot helped finish the first group of three.

lxc_4c63225ed99f3c76.text: In 1993, the Bulls played the Phoenix Suns in the Finals.

lxc_3b3ab9df2f51d7d7.text: In Game 6, John Paxson made a three-point shot, and the Bulls won the game.

lxc_846aa8c10e52d386.text: That shot gave them their third title in a row.

lxc_2a8791d66ff3c47a.text: So the Bulls show something new.

lxc_33f19a2d7da714f1.text: A team does not need many titles to be special.

lxc_4bc24d07e38ecc1a.text: Six titles in a short time, in two clear groups, makes a strong story too.

lxc_2d10483d48bbf1fe.text: The first three teams are often measured by titles.

lxc_4c71fe49de6f8447.text: The Warriors also show another kind of strength: winning again and again inside one season.

lxc_6855dc79ee4d47b9.text: The Warriors are third in NBA championships, after the Lakers and the Celtics.

lxc_5ebc5a7635524893.text: They are also third in Finals games played, after the same two teams.

lxc_91f8df2f86a884b3.text: Between 2015 and 2016, the Warriors started a season better than any NBA team before them.

lxc_01bd3ed76e36007b.text: They also won game after game without losing, longer than any team before.

lxc_db066198cd26783b.text: Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson played together near the back of the court.

lxc_4f015ab2d3d32473.text: They helped make this time so strong.

lxc_ca3e8b3fe784bb9a.text: The Warriors also met the Celtics in the 2022 Finals, and the Warriors won.

lxc_bfc2630ba5fd1745.text: So the third team on the list beat the team with the most titles.

lxc_ac14dfbdb12ba236.text: Now let's put the four teams next to each other.

lxc_76041697207107a6.text: But now look at the shape of the wins.

lxc_f4ed9dcde5af7991.text: The Celtics won eight in a row in the 1960s.

lxc_b18b8ddba2fccb8d.text: The Lakers won while moving from city to city, and they beat the Celtics in Boston.

lxc_0c729c47cc7b74af.text: The Bulls won six titles in two groups of three.

lxc_91d6040ebc1c1953.text: The Warriors broke records inside one season and beat the Celtics in 2022.

lxc_107b702bd7494849.text: So a number is like the score at the end of a game.

lxc_25e2597fd579610c.text: It tells you who won, but not how they played.

lxc_a91af627f3fd321e.text: To understand a team, you need the number and the story together.
